reviewer: Claude Code (AI coding assistant), at the operator's request; not checked by a human
scope: Every line of the v2 trace (critic in the loop) that passed check_line and the critic (218 of 232), read against its English source fact.
rule: Same rule as the first (v1) review: reject a rewrite that adds a detail not in the fact, changes its meaning, overstates the data, or is not correct, idiomatic language. Tone and point of view alone are allowed. A rejected line shows its English source on the page, marked as kept.

rejections.text: The goal started with a ball-winning tackle followed by 6 precise passes.
rejections.reason: adds detail not in the fact ("precise" passes)

rejections.text: Full time: Eastvale Athletic drehen das Spiel und gewinnen 2-3
rejections.reason: not correct language: English words ("Full time") in a German title

rejections.text: Ugo Vale erzielte den Siegtreffer in der 81. Minute, nachdem sein Schuss in der 38. Minute großartig pariert wurde.
rejections.reason: adds detail not in the fact ("großartig" pariert)

rejections.text: Das Tor entstand direkt aus einer abgefangenen Aktion.
rejections.reason: not correct language: "abgefangenen Aktion" is not an idiomatic way to say interception

rejections.text: Northbridge Rovers hatten mehr Schüsse (14–11), aber Eastvale Athletic die besseren Chancen (synthetisches xG, ein Heuristik: 3.04 gegen 2.05).
rejections.reason: not correct language: grammar error "ein Heuristik"
not correct language: "Майже для" does not mean "so close for"
changes the meaning: "Нічия" reads as a drawn match, not as drawing level

rejections.text: На 71-й хвилині Eastvale Athletic поступалися 2-1. Голі на 77-й і 81-й хвилинах змінили рахунок.
Northbridge Rovers поступалися 0-1 на 5-й хвилині. Голі на 56-й та 71-й хвилинах змінили хід гри.
Eastvale Athletic відставали 2-1 на 71-й хвилині. Голі на 77-й та 81-й хвилинах змінили хід матчу.

rejections.reason: changes the meaning: "Ведучий гол змінювався двічі" (the leading goal changed twice) for "the lead changed hands twice"

rejections.text: Northbridge Rovers зробили більше ударів (14–11), але Eastvale Athletic мали кращі шанси за synthetic xG (3.04 проти 2.05).
rejections.reason: not correct language: English "synthetic" in a Ukrainian line
